digest.description: Empty to use image.tag, or an OCI image digest written as sha256:<64 lowercase hex characters>.

image.description: Empty to leave cloud provisioning off, or the provisioning runner pinned by content digest (repository@sha256:<64 lowercase hex characters>). A tag is refused here as well as by the agent: this is the process that holds a role over your cloud account while it runs, and a tag is a name somebody can re-point after you approved it.
